module: Tests of the transition failure contract of router.lua: routeMounted rejected before commit, routeChangeFailed rollback for an uncommitted navigation, rejections with no active transition, after commit or with a stale identifier. File run by the test framework, not an API for modders.
notes: The tests drive the real ui_router singleton with a fabricated transition, then reset TransitionManager and restore any pending entry.

testRouteMountedRejectedBeforeCommit.desc: routeMounted is rejected with not_committed until the route change is committed.

testRouteChangeFailedRollsBackUncommitte.desc: routeChangeFailed clears the pending entry and ends the transition.

testRouteChangeFailedRejectedWithoutActi.desc: routeChangeFailed is rejected if there is no active transition.

testRouteChangeFailedRejectedAfterCommit.desc: routeChangeFailed is rejected once the route is already committed.

testRouteChangeFailedRejectsStaleTransit.desc: routeChangeFailed rejects a different transition identifier so as not to cancel a more recent navigation.
